Mike Patrick is the guy in the center. My father thinks he was a ranger, special operations group for MACV. He was what you would call a ghost or a spook, my father says he doesn’t know why they called him this or referred to him of this.

My father said the kid in the bottom right held a m1 grande and these kids were in training
researchNotes: Larry's words relayed third-person by his son, who typed on his own @mdfmkl account during the 2026-08-15 session (Larry dictating at the table). Cataloged on VN-0010. Answers the survey's open question — the tall central American is Mike Patrick, not Sgt. Lowry. 'Special operations group for MACV' reads naturally as MACV-SOG; treated as a lead on his person record.
